doc.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022

title: Seeing Cannonball Adderley
summary: He recalls seeing Cannonball's group in the Fiddler on the Roof era and being amazed by his fingers and positivity.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: Let me run a couple of names by you, if you saw them or if their particular personality or musicianship meant much to you. Cannonball Adderley?

Yes. Man, I remember seeing him with the “Fiddler on the Roof” gig with Charles Lloyd, Joe Zawinul, Sam Jones and Louis Hayes and Nat of course. And I nudged a guy next to me and said, “Man he doesn’t move his fingers.” He played this real fast thing and like a little twitch like Charlie Parker’s. You know like slight of hand movement you know. It just amazed me. Not to mention him talking on the mic and being so positive and uplifting. Yeah. What an — amazing.
